readerAnswers.data: “No training” does not mean “no data processing.”
readerAnswers.limit: Privacy protection does not establish learning value.
readerAnswers.action: Ask which exact product is being assigned and whether the school incorporated these standards into its agreement.

terms.generative AI: software that creates text or other content from instructions
terms.training: changing an AI model for future use
terms.telemetry: anonymous technical records about how a service operates

explainBack: The school must request the protections for a covered education product. Data-use restrictions protect information, while accuracy and teaching value need separate checks.
unseenTransfer: A teacher using a general work assistant on a school account cannot infer coverage from the vendor name or licence. Check the product definition and incorporated agreement.
repairsMade: Omitted November1 rollout rather than extending AP’s broad wording beyond signed opt-in scope.
Kept telemetry and narrow safety exceptions beside no-training promise.
Kept accuracy and educational-appropriateness limits separate.
limitations: Producer simulated explain-back and transfer; no human comprehension test.
Source art and supplied mobile preview admitted; integrated runtime not reviewed.
